title: Westeville Ohio Part 2 It Got Cut Off
author: Chris Trevethan
event_desc: a sanctioned tournament in Westerville, Ohio (an Origins warm-up)

games.note: timed loss ('Tl 0(-17)'); the game began in part 1 of the report, which the archive does not have, so the opponent is not named

games.opponent_objective: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die
games.note: report: 'joe shnaduts court capture deck'; 'i win by 30'

games.opponent_objective: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

summary: Chris Trevethan finished 5th at a tournament in Westerville, Ohio, going 2–2 (4 points, +27) with an EBO deck and a Dark deck; Justin Danenberg won and Brian Sykes was 2nd.
notes: Part 2 of a report whose first part is not in the archive; it begins mid-way through game 1. The timed loss in game 1 ('Tl 0(-17)') is recorded with no opponent.

Same event as d2555 (Brian Sykes, 'Columbus OH Origins warm-up 6-30-01', Comic Town, Westerville): Sykes names Trevethan, Kyle, Justin and Roger the TD. Event named 'June 2001 Westerville tournament'; the date 30 June 2001 is from d2555's title, not this report (it only says the tournament came before Origins) — the d2555 file must use the same event name. Site from this report's title ('Westeville Ohio'), corrected to Westerville.

'1st justin danibergs(sp?)' mapped to [[Justin Danenberg]] (Columbus, Ohio winner in January 2001; author flags the spelling). '2end brain sykies yes the world runner up for trek' mapped to [[Brian Sykes]] (d2555's author, who says he finished 2nd).

Standings also give '4th ?' and say 'joe takes last' and the author's cousin second to last; not recorded. Brian Sykes (d2555) tentatively lists Trevethan 4th and Kyle 5th ('dont hold me to that'); this report says 3rd Kyle, 5th Trevethan.
Opponent 'joe shnaduts' recorded as Joe Shnadut (spelling as in the report, possessive dropped; no page). Kyle: first name only.

Author's Light deck is EBO (Echo Base Operations; not an objective) with podracing; his Dark deck flips an objective but is not described, so no Dark objective is given. A live deck page 'Chris Trevethan Ebo racing extreme' (posted 24 June 2001) is probably the same EBO deck, but it is not confirmed as this exact list, so deck_page is null.
Game 4 opponent deck: 'kyles dark i forget bhbm' read as BHBM with the author's uncertainty kept in the deck text.
